title: DepMGNN: Matrixial Graph Neural Network for Video-based Automatic Depression Assessment

layout.note: Two purple-framed numbered panels side by side, a wide one for the three method columns and a narrow one for the two toy graphs stacked top and bottom; inside panel 1 the columns share one skeleton from film strip at the bottom to prediction at the top.

lesson: Draw the baselines and the proposal as columns that share one skeleton so only the point where they differ changes, then repeat that difference in a small second panel at glyph level (slab versus feature map, single value versus matrix) with a one-line verdict under each.
